semantic_context: Effective firmware, connection type, readiness and protocol-authentication contracts were read together. Raw HID sessions publish ready before lazy wire initialization and leave inherited firmware at 0.0.0; Security Domain can use an assumed version. Capability queries remain available after disposal. C001 narrows the generic wording.

The public base promises IDisposable/IAsyncDisposable and Type only. It supplies no admission, scheduling, copied-input, native cancellation or release-proof implementation. Prefer await using without importing platform-wide guarantees.

Internal protocol borrows connection; SCP decorator owns wrapped protocol and keys, not connection. Configure follows applet probing. One logical-exchange overlap refusal and applet backend borrowing match implementations; whole applet workflows need separate exclusion.

Read every standard/vendor command, mask, length and channel constant. Unencoded CBOR=10, MSG=03, INIT=06, CANCEL=11; on-wire initialization mask is 80. The 7609 limit is 57+128*59 for SDK fixed64 reports. Vendor C0/C2/C3 are already encoded values, normalized during correlation. CTAP payload status00 is a different field.

Compatibility adapter synchronously copies64, calls SetReport then clears copy; receive synchronously obtains exact64 and returns that array. Neither method checks its token. Dispose/DisposeAsync close the underlying report facade synchronously. These mechanics are not Linux/macOS typed-owner guarantees.

Read full handshake, frame construction, keepalive, cancellation, validation, response assembly and both disposal paths. Broadcast nonce handshake accepts >=17 bytes, extracts CID and vendor-defined version but does not reject reserved assigned CIDs. Guard spans lazy INIT plus request and response. CANCEL is observed only after keepalive; CBOR late success special-case compares unnormalized command. Partial-response arrays clear, input report arrays remain. AsyncLocal prevents direct self-disposal of this protocol. See C002/C003/C005/C006.

Read public Tier2 lifetime/exclusion XML with compatibility adapter and B1/B2/B3 owner evidence. Packet borrow lasts through actual task terminal; macOS-specific read detach/send drain is scoped correctly, but opening assertion is too universal for direct/custom connections (C004). Connection PacketSize remains SDK64.

Internal command overload without notification routes to None, second overload requests only. Commands are CTAPHID rather than CTAP2 operations. Initialize is guarded and Configure is local. C002 records command-class and cancellation limits; protocol firmware is separate from session's inherited property.

Internal one-method wake capability has no universal cancellation or release contract. Active protocol disposal invokes it only when drain is pending and connection implements it; B2/B3 own native consequences.

Read reflected bitwise CRC algorithm: initial FFFF, polynomial8408, eight steps per byte, no final complement in CalculateCrc; CheckCrc compares F0B8 residue over caller-selected prefix. Caller must supply a valid in-bounds length. Outbound slot-frame CRC differs from inner slot configuration CRC.

Read both command overloads and default notification fallback to silent overload. Built-in implementation forwards notification; interface default allows silent custom internal fakes. Data includes command-specific CRC; ReadStatus returns six bytes with firmware prefix. Guard is exchange-scoped.

Read every report/frame/status/command constant against vendor header and Python. Eight report bytes contain seven payload bytes plus control/sequence at7; status programming sequence is report offset4. ResponseLengthOffset64/ResponseCrcOffset65 need C007 qualification because data responses have command-defined lengths, not a universal outbound-frame layout.

Compatibility send clones8, synchronously calls SetReport, clears finally; receive exact8 returns report storage. Cancellation parameter is unused. Disposal closes underlying report facade synchronously. Public typed native owners bypass this adapter on built-in Linux/macOS.

Read complete lazy status/NEO refresh, padded64 and frame70, write readiness, status progseq, touch polling, pending response sequence0..31, terminal0 reset, pool clearing, abort failure latch and disposal. ReadStatus aliases the returned report's six-byte middle. Report length is assumed at internal connection contract; broad NEO catch and tight polling are C007 decisions, input-report leftovers are C005.

Internal TimeoutException subtype arises only after observed touch-wait and local timeout. It lets applet HidBackend distinguish TimedOut from transport/readiness TimeoutException; no device-native deadline or successful abort is implied.

Read all overloads: runtime interface matching SmartCard, FIDO, OTP in that priority, not connection.Type flags. Creates internal borrowing protocols and category loggers; unsupported connection throws before protocol use. Factory tests deliberately report Type Unknown while implementing typed interfaces.

All nine public getters return fresh copies of private AID arrays. Fido and FidoU2f same bytes select shared FIDO applet; Memory read-only is not immutable backing storage. Copies protect subsequent selection, not secret erasure. Rust/Python comparison in guard is separately unverified (C009).

Full constructor/bind/prepare/configure/callback/readiness, presence helper, failure cleanup, queries and sync/async disposal read. Bind occurs after successful construction before wire. Prepare stores protocol before SCP validation/INIT; Configure records version/auth only after SCP success; full callback later sets readiness. Creation failure synchronously disposes and suppresses cleanup/log errors. Disposal clears flags immediately, drains protocol then detaches and disposes owned connection once; borrowed survives. No whole-operation lease, detached-task tracking or universal initialization cancellation rollback (C001/C006).

ConditionalWeakTable uses reference-key identity; locked Slot holds session strongly while connection lives. Attach refuses incumbent; Detach checks exact holder; unbound initialize rejected. This coordinates sessions, not raw direct calls or independently opened handles. Canonical Rust/Python claim lacks exact original reference (C009).

Creation prechecks token, binds, creates borrowing protocol and publishes ready without wire; first send lazy INIT plus guarded exchange. None suppresses prompt. Request borrowed through framing, result transfers. Inherited firmware never populated from protocol; C001/C002/C003 qualify raw contract.

Creation binds with no status I/O and sets ready. First exchange initializes before copying caller payload. Returns unvalidated command-specific response; caller-selected CRC length needs valid bounds. Abort/reset latch and reconnect warning are accurate. Inherited firmware stays default (C001); request lifetime needs explicit C004 wording.

Simple creation sends no SELECT/APDU and starts firmware unknown; explicit SCP creation configures before handshake and sets authenticated on successful initialization. Select sends supplied AID; Transmit returns response owner with optional error throwing; Configure rejects established SCP and records firmware only after guarded configuration success. B6 owns formatter/SCP details; inspect status before Clear.

Read all five init-only settings and WithPreferredConnectionType's shallow copy. Configuration is value-carried, SCP and prompt remain caller-owned references. Factories stop retaining options after creation; Security Domain retains parameters for reset, Management/SD ignore prompt. Override never skips probing and raw factories do not accept this type (C001/C009).

Read every admission/drain overload and lock transition. Entry checks caller token, closing, overlap; delegate gets None; finally Exit signals shared drain with asynchronous continuations. Run synchronously guards configuration. No callback reentry detection, whole-workflow lease, native cancel or liveness bound (C006).

Configure overlap test's name says Throws but asserts successful Configure. Missing finally release can deadlock using disposal on failed assertion (C008).
